release.note: Settled. README 'Covered in particular' now takes the n_rows limit from in_off ((n_rows − 1)·input_row_stride < 2^31): 131072 × 16384 (the last row starts at 131071·16384 < 2^31) and 169467 × 12672 (169466·12672 < 2^31; one more row is not) are right, and the 64-bit pointer addition of the column offsets matches ptr_get. The lane_facts docstring now states the theorem's bound, (2^-22 + 2^-33)·a + (3·2^-24 + 2^-33)·(w·a) + 2^-139 with w = mx − xs j.

notes: My round-1 F3 had the 16384-column limit off by one (131073); the README's 131072 is right.
